config.combatnumbers.title: Combat Numbers
config.combatnumbers.option.enabled.tool: Enables or disables all combat numbers detection and rendering.
config.combatnumbers.option.theme.toolti: Selects the base theme. Leave blank for no theme. Resource packs and custom server data are layered on top of the theme.
config.combatnumbers.option.theme.off.de: No theme applied. Clean slate for resource packs, datapacks or server overrides.
config.combatnumbers.option.renderMode.t: Changes how the floating text is rendered.
config.combatnumbers.option.baseFontSize: How large the text is. This is also affected by your GUI scale setting.
config.combatnumbers.option.showThroughW: When enabled, floating text renders through walls. May get noisy near mob farms.
config.combatnumbers.option.nearFadeDist: Text will begin fading out from this distance (in blocks) as you get nearer.
config.combatnumbers.option.maxRenderDis: Maximum distance (in blocks) before the text stops rendering. If you are on dedicated servers, this could be limited to the server's own settings.
config.combatnumbers.option.distanceFall: Distance (in blocks) at which text will begin to appear smaller in size.
Distance (in blocks) at which the text reaches its minimum scale.
config.combatnumbers.option.distanceMinS: Minimum scale at max distance falloff.
config.combatnumbers.option.reset.toolti: Reset this option to its default value.
config.combatnumbers.resetAll.tooltip: Reset all options to their default values.
Renders floating text in the world. Legacy mode. May render behind entities, water and translucent objects. May not work well with shaders.
config.combatnumbers.renderOption.SCREEN: Renders floating text in the world, directly in front of the camera. Deprecated. May render behind entities, water and translucent objects. May not work well with shaders. Unusable due to view bobbing.
config.combatnumbers.renderOption.HUD.to: Renders floating text on the HUD. Recommended to leave this option selected. Only consider other options if you are having issues with this one.
